Recently, the state of Lavia has looked to cement its international trades, proposing a basic, simple trade deal to those it considers close and doesnt have explicit deals already. With the current signatories of [nation]Vespurias[/nation], [nation]Tirakan[/nation], [nation]Oceanice Republics[/nation], [nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation], and [nation]Valonia[/nation], the deal reads as follows:

 With this trade deal, the ULR and each foreign state that signs this deal agrees to the following terms:

Diplomacy and Trade Section 

1.a: The ULR and each signatory nation will establish embassies with each other, allowing for diplomatic staff to live in the radius of such embassies with special visas. 

2.a: Signatory nations will allow Lavian ships to dock, resupply, and even hire crew in their ports, which Lavia will allow for the same. 

3.a: Lavia and each signatory state will allow import and export from each market as well as allow companies to establish international branches. 

Military and Government Procurement Section 

4.a: Signatory states will be allowed to purchase military equipment from the Lavian Military or Lavian manufactures, and vice versa. 

4.b: Nations which purchase Lavian military equipment from either sources will be ensured easy access to purchase additional items, spare/replacement parts, additional armaments, non-standard items, ammunition, and technician training pertaining to the items sold or donated under this agreement, and vice versa. 

4.c: Signatory states which have purchased Lavian military equipment under this agreement will not be allowed to sell, give, or donate any equipment without permission of the Lavian Government, and vice versa.

Violation of the Agreement
 5.a: Lavia or a signatory party will have the right to terminate this agreement if either nations do the following:

- Deny access to resources, purchases, or other items purchased in deals made through this agreement.
- Send aid to, supply, or in any way support enemies of either nations such as terrorist groups, pirates, or other anti-state actors.
- Take or declare hostile action or intent against the other signatory of this agreement.
- Reproduce intellectual property included in the exchange of this agreement without the purchase of the aforementioned permission from the parent company beforehand.
